import os,shutil,subprocess,sys,json,hashlib,tempfile,pathlib,csv,datetime
SRC='products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example'
OUT='products/services/shopify-large-catalogue/reproduction'
pathlib.Path(OUT).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
EX='''"""Minimal runnable example for verify.py. Made by autonomous AI agents (GlobalLand).
Usage: python3 verify_example.py VARIANTS.csv IMAGES.csv OUTPUT.csv [OUTPUT2.csv ...]
Inputs are read by header name (style_id,title,vendor,product_type,tags,color,size,sku,barcode,price and style_id,color,position,url).
Prints every check as JSON. Exit 0 = all checks passed, 1 = a check failed, 2 = bad usage.
It only re-reads files; it does not prove that Shopify will accept the import."""
import csv, json, os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from verify import verify
VC = ['style_id', 'title', 'vendor', 'product_type', 'tags', 'color', 'size', 'sku', 'barcode', 'price']
IC = ['style_id', 'color', 'position', 'url']


def rows(path, cols):
    with open(path, newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        return [[r.get(c) or '' for c in cols] for r in csv.DictReader(f)]


if len(sys.argv) < 4:
    print(__doc__)
    sys.exit(2)
chk, nrows, nprod = verify(sys.argv[3:], rows(sys.argv[1], VC), rows(sys.argv[2], IC))
print(json.dumps({'rows': nrows, 'products': nprod, 'checks': chk, 'failed': [k for k, v in chk.items() if not v]}, indent=1))
sys.exit(0 if all(chk.values()) else 1)
'''
open(OUT+'/verify_example.py','w').write(EX)
d=tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='dl-')
DL=['transform.py','verify.py','fixtures/before-variants.csv','fixtures/before-images.csv','fixtures/after-shopify.csv']
for f in DL:
  os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.join(d,f)),exist_ok=True); shutil.copy(os.path.join(SRC,f),os.path.join(d,f))
shutil.copy(OUT+'/verify_example.py',d)
sh=lambda p: hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest()
log=[]
def run(cmd):
  r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=d,capture_output=True,text=True)
  log.append({'cmd':' '.join(cmd),'rc':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout[-2500:],'stderr':r.stderr[-1500:]}); return r
t=run(['python3','-I','transform.py','--variants','fixtures/before-variants.csv','--images','fixtures/before-images.csv','--out','shopify.csv','--report','report.json'])
same=open(d+'/shopify.csv','rb').read()==open(d+'/fixtures/after-shopify.csv','rb').read()
good=run(['python3','-I','verify_example.py','fixtures/before-variants.csv','fixtures/before-images.csv','shopify.csv'])
with open(d+'/shopify.csv',newline='',encoding='utf-8') as f: R=list(csv.reader(f))
H=R[0]; si=H.index('SKU'); bi=H.index('Barcodes'); ui=H.index('Product image URL')
def wr(name,rows):
  with open(d+'/'+name,'w',newline='',encoding='utf-8') as f: csv.writer(f,lineterminator='\n').writerows(rows)
A=[list(r) for r in R]; k=next(i for i in range(1,len(A)) if A[i][si]); old=A[k][bi]; A[k][bi]=old[:-1]+('9' if old[-1]!='9' else '8'); wr('corrupt-barcode.csv',A)
B=[list(r) for r in R]; j=next(i for i in range(1,len(B)) if not B[i][si] and B[i][ui]); dropped=B[j][ui]; del B[j]; wr('omitted-image.csv',B)
cb=run(['python3','-I','verify_example.py','fixtures/before-variants.csv','fixtures/before-images.csv','corrupt-barcode.csv'])
oi=run(['python3','-I','verify_example.py','fixtures/before-variants.csv','fixtures/before-images.csv','omitted-image.csv'])
us=run(['python3','-I','verify_example.py'])
f=lambda r: json.loads(r.stdout)['failed'] if r.stdout.strip().startswith('{') else None
res={'synthetic_inputs':True,'observed_at':datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat()+'Z','note':'Fresh temp directory containing only the public site downloads plus verify_example.py. Proves reproducibility of the sample only; no Shopify import, customer, acquisition or revenue.',
 'download_sha256':{x:sh(os.path.join(d,x)) for x in DL},'verify_example_sha256':sh(OUT+'/verify_example.py'),
 'transform_rc':t.returncode,'output_sha256':sh(d+'/shopify.csv'),'output_byte_identical_to_published_expected':same,
 'verify_expected':{'rc':good.returncode,'failed':f(good)},
 'corrupted_identifier':{'row':k,'barcode_before':old,'barcode_after':A[k][bi],'rc':cb.returncode,'failed':f(cb)},
 'omitted_image':{'row':j,'dropped_url':dropped,'rc':oi.returncode,'failed':f(oi)},
 'usage_without_args_rc':us.returncode}
res['pass']=t.returncode==0 and same and good.returncode==0 and cb.returncode==1 and 'identifiers_preserved_sku_barcode_color_size_price' in (f(cb) or []) and oi.returncode==1 and 'all_input_images_present_once_per_product' in (f(oi) or []) and us.returncode==2
json.dump(res,open(OUT+'/reproduction-result.json','w'),indent=1)
json.dump(log,open(OUT+'/command-log.json','w'),indent=1)
print(json.dumps(res,indent=1))
